dedupe_keys.name: dataset of multiple water quality parameters measured in a drinking water distribution system

description: Five CSV datasets describe water-quality sensors deployed at four locations. YSI EXO 3 and ATI MetriNet Q52 measurements include temperature, conductivity, turbidity, pH and chlorine at five-minute intervals over periods of weeks to months. Maintenance logs and plotting code accompany them. This resource is provided by Lina Sela. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists CSV formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Individual observation campaigns require Q2; location names and exact measurement periods are not established in the reviewed description. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
